verdict.rationale: incident.io ships AI features such as Investigations, Suggestions, Scribe and AI post-mortems, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The trust-and-safety material covers keeping the investigation agent within the bounds you set, not training use of data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
